// @autogenerated
[#observed-source]
= Observed source

Origin allowed to send telemetry (logs and traces): the application itself, a client application or an api. It is the only table the ingestion checks. The rows of the referenced entities (oauth clients, resource servers) are created and updated by the synchronization of the trait; the others are created by hand. It is not tenant data: only the managers of the platform see it.

== Dónde se encuentra

No aparece en el menú: se llega desde otra entidad.

== Campos

[cols="2,2,1,5",options="header"]
|===
|Campo |Tipo |Obligatorio |Detalles

|clase de origen
|Texto
|Sí
|Where the origin comes from: app (a client application), api (a resource server), self (this application) or own (created by hand).

|ref. de origen
|Texto
|No
|Identifier of the row of the referenced entity (oauth client or resource server). Not a foreign key, so the referenced row can be deleted: the origin is then marked as detached.

|administrado
|Sí / no
|Sí
|The origin is kept in sync from a referenced entity: its code, name and origin-enabled are overwritten by the synchronization. Valor inicial: «false».

|código
|Texto
|Sí
|Code of the origin, sent with every event as its source (service name).

|Nombre
|Texto
|No
|Name shown in the viewer.

|tipo
|Opción de una lista
|No
|What the origin is: it chooses its predefined dashboard and the suggested SDK. Valores posibles: «administración», «front-end», «compañero de trabajo/compañera de trabajo», «móvil». Valor inicial: «administración».

|origen habilitado
|Sí / no
|Sí
|Copy of the enabled flag of the referenced entity: a disabled client or api cannot send telemetry. Valor inicial: «true».

|separado
|Sí / no
|Sí
|The referenced row was deleted. The origin and its data are kept, but it cannot send telemetry. Valor inicial: «false».

|Medioambiente
|Texto
|No
|Deployment environment of the origin (dev, pre, pro...), shown in the viewer.

|clave de importación
|Texto
|No
|Key the origin sends in the X-Observe-Key header. Generated at random when the origin is created; only the administrators of the observability see it.

|Orígenes CORS permitidos
|Texto
|No
|Comma-separated web origins (scheme://host:port) a browser can send from with this key. Empty to accept only server to server calls.

|Nivel mínimo
|Texto
|No
|Minimum level of the logs that are stored: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR or FATAL. Valor inicial: «INFO».

|frecuencia de muestreo del seguimiento
|Número entero
|No
|Percentage (0-100) of the traces that are stored; the traces with errors are always stored. Valor inicial: «100».

|frecuencia de muestreo de errores
|Número entero
|No
|Percentage (0-100) of the error events that are stored. Valor inicial: «100».

|límite de tarifa
|Número entero
|No
|Events per minute accepted from the origin; the excess is discarded and counted in dropped-count. Valor inicial: «600».

|modo de métricas
|Opción de una lista
|No
|How the metrics of the origin arrive: push (OTLP or the SDK), scrape (the collector reads scrape-url) or disabled. Valores posibles: «empujar», «raspado», «desactivado». Valor inicial: «empujar».

|extraer datos de la URL
|Texto
|No
|Prometheus endpoint the collector reads when metrics-mode is scrape (e.g. http://billing:8080/q/metrics).

|intervalo de recopilación de datos
|Número entero
|No
|Seconds between two reads of scrape-url. Valor inicial: «60».

|Serie MAX
|Número entero
|No
|Maximum number of metric series of the origin; the new ones above it are added to an __overflow__ series. Valor inicial: «2000».

|obtener métricas
|Sí / no
|No
|Computes RED metrics from the spans and counts from the logs and errors of the origin. Valor inicial: «true».

|Retención (Dias)
|Número entero
|No
|Days the data of the origin are kept. Empty to use the global retention of the configuration.

|campos de matorral
|Texto
|No
|Comma-separated extra keys masked in the events of the origin, besides the global ones of the configuration.

|Visto por última a las
|Fecha y hora
|No
|When the last event of the origin arrived (updated at most once a minute).

|número de paquetes perdidos
|Número entero
|No
|Events of the origin discarded by the rate limit or because the queue was full (saved every minute by the collector). Lo calcula la aplicación: no se edita.

|se espera cada minuto
|Número entero
|No
|The origin is expected to send something at least every these minutes; the source-silent alert rules use it instead of their window. Empty: the window of the rule.

|habilitado
|Sí / no
|Sí
|A disabled origin is rejected by the ingestion, without deleting it or its data. Valor inicial: «false». Lo calcula la aplicación: no se edita.
|===

== Acciones

[cols="1,3",options="header"]
|===
|Acción |Qué hace

|Crear
|Da de alta un elemento nuevo.

|Consultar
|Muestra los valores de un elemento.

|Editar
|Cambia los valores de un elemento.

|Borrar
|Borra un elemento, o los seleccionados, tras confirmarlo.

|Enable
|Deja _habilitado_ en «true».

|Disable
|Deja _habilitado_ en «false».
|===

== Validaciones

Además de los campos obligatorios, al guardar se comprueban estas reglas. Si alguna no se cumple, el formulario marca los campos implicados con el mensaje y no deja guardar.

* No puede haber dos elementos con el mismo valor de _código_.
* No puede haber dos elementos con el mismo valor de _clave de importación_.
